strategy.title: No plan: the overhaul exchange deal needs $34,000 of capital against a $2,000 ceiling
strategy.why: One written acceptance at $40,000 with a $34,000 AeroSpares unit cost would net $6,000 and settle in 20 days, but the unit must be funded up front ($34,000 exposure), 17x the $2,000 capital allowed.

alternatives.title: Ask AeroSpares for buyer-paid or deferred-payment terms
alternatives.why: If the MRO shop paid a deposit covering the $34,000 before purchase, exposure would fall under $2,000; no such terms are evidenced.

sources.claim: Exposure / direct cost $34,000 per unit (AeroSpares Exchange quote)

noPlan.decisiveGap: ECONOMICS within CAPITAL: the only opening needs $34,000 committed up front to buy the exchange unit before the buyer's $40,000 settles; the goal allows $2,000.
noPlan.resolution: Negotiate buyer deposit / supplier drop-ship-on-payment terms so exposure stays under $2,000, or raise the capital ceiling to at least $34,000.

excluded.why: Requires $34,000 peak funding, above the $2,000 capital ceiling.

constraints.suggestion: Allow at least $34,000 of capital, or secure buyer prepayment covering the unit cost.
